purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kabuchai Form 34B and preserve a genuine internal document inconsistency without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 120 DPI (2-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF). Page 2 carries both the polling-station table's own TOTAL row and, further down the same page, the form's separate Aggregate Results and Voter Turnout summary boxes. The two sets of figures on this page do not match each other.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and both the polling-station TOTAL row and the Aggregate Results/Voter Turnout boxes were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the polling-station-level TOTAL row, separately cross-checked against the form's own Aggregate Results table.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-218-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: The polling-station-level TOTAL row on page 2 reads Registered Voters 67,221 (matching the governed P23 denominator exactly) with candidate cells 10,680 + 32,221 + 193 + 385 = 43,479, exactly equal to that row's own printed Total Valid Votes (43,479) and Rejected Ballots 425. However, the same page's separate Aggregate Results table prints different candidate totals -- 10,798 + 32,216 + 192 + 271 = 43,477 -- and the Voter Turnout box states 'Total Number of Voters who turned out to vote' as 43,477 (matching the Aggregate Results sum, not the polling-station TOTAL row's Total Valid Votes of 43,479). The two per-candidate result sets differ by up to 118 votes (Odinga: 10,680 vs 10,798) despite both appearing on the same official document. This is a genuine internal inconsistency on the source document itself (two different, non-reconciling candidate tallies), not a legibility or transcription question -- both figures are clearly printed. Per the extraction contract's prohibition on selecting one of two conflicting source totals to force a reconciliation, this row is left unresolved: registered_voters and total_valid_votes are recorded as source_conflicting_within_document with no single verified_value, and no turnout observation is promoted from this evidence.
